title: Host-only review of prepared P19 acceptance and resume commands
disposition: Core CLI/workload design is coherent; refresh prelaunch source pins and complete prerequisite reviews before root admission. No command was executed and no files were changed outside this review.
scope: Prepared P19 acceptance command, separate resumed-prefill command, runner source, installed datatype-sweep requirements. No model/device execution, admission, HF, or TTNN imports.

confirmed.evidence: P19 is BF16/HiFi4 attention, MLP and head; down is BFP8/LoFi; activations/residual/CCL, logits/sampling, embedding/norm are BF16; KV is BFP8; max_seq_len=262144; no exceptions. `--config` points to this exact file and command pin matches current SHA.

Reference provenance records google/gemma-4-31B-it and tokenizer at revision 842da3794eaa0b77d5f08bae87a17459d91ff475; optimized reference metadata independently pins the same revision and 100 generated AIME tokens. AIME ref is chat-templated, 161 prompt tokens and 100 scored positions; natural ref is 512 prefix + 512 contiguous book positions at offset4096. Both `.refpt` hashes in the command match.

`run_datatype_candidate.py` performs one prefill evaluation and three teacher-forcing decode runs for AIME, plus one natural-text run. `--require-accuracy` enforces top1>=0.90, top5>=0.98 and top100==1.0 on prefill, decode and natural, and verifies replay counts/no new captures. Three decode rows are retained for root inspection; the threshold directly evaluates the first decode result, so verify all three retained score rows clear the bar.

Batch=1 default and `--acceptance` path execute fixed4096-input/128-generated autoregression; the optimized-generation harness compares streaming/buffered output and takes three timing repeats with 127 model replays each. It also runs a 32k retained-notes/128-token long-prefix task, six pinned HF qualitative controls, and physical/context probes at prompt lengths262143 and262144. The boundary test checks the final in-range decode position and exact-capacity prefill; it is not a quality test.

The suite has 6 chat prompts. The HF prompt-format artifact pins the same revision (842da3794eaa0b77d5f08bae87a17459d91ff475) and stop IDs. TT `generate()` defaults to greedy temperature0/top_k1/top_p1 and the runner records complete TT/HF text plus first divergence; it does not decide quality. The command explicitly requires later human inspection.

Separate B1 run uses natural text, lengths2560/16384, block sizes32/64, sliding window1024, default window256, and the default no_history/fresh_suffix negative controls. The installed helper includes unaligned resume starts132 and1029 plus window start1024, block-aligned32/64, prefix-cache and last-token starts at each length. max_seq_len16384 is expressly diagnostic allocation only; 262144 boundary coverage is in the acceptance command.
Every source hash currently listed in both command JSON files matches its file. The acceptance run directory and resume output are absent; both commands remain prepared_not_admitted_not_run.

Acceptance forecast600/1500/3000s under3600s hard timeout; resume forecast750/1200/2100s under2700s. Both retain600s over their stated high estimates. Acceptance forecast explicitly notes P19 full-context prefill has not been timed. Recompute deadline and owner gates at admission.

findings_before_launch.finding: The acceptance command pins runner/helper files, P19 config/review and two `.refpt` files but omits read-time input and runtime hashes: `reference_metadata.json`, `aime24_prompt.json` (copied and used for 4096 workload), `qualitative_hf.json` and `qualitative_prompt_format.json` (copied/compared), `references.json` (HF/model/token provenance), plus model `tt/*.py` runtime including `weights.py` (HF revision) and `generator.py` (sampling defaults). run_datatype_candidate writes a retrospective `source_manifest.json` for `tt/*.py` after it starts; that is not an expected prelaunch pin. Add these pins to frozen command/proposal/admission. Also pin the installed readiness modules used by accuracy and resume paths; current hashes are listed in `currently_unpinned_inputs`.

Both commands remain inert and make P19 full-panel and cap-extension closure a prerequisite. The five-row cap-extension batch has terminal evidence and independent triage, but root adjudication/review should be pinned in the eventual admission; prose `requires` is not an executable gate.

Three decode score rows are preserved but the CLI score assertion reads the first decode measurement. Verify all retained repeat scores in the terminal review; do not infer quality or acceptance from process exit alone.

forecast_and_cli_issues.timeout_assessment: No demonstrated timeout defect; configured timeouts exceed forecast highs by600s. Recompute remaining deadline and device/HF ownership at root admission.

resume_non_aligned_starts.basis: Static calculation from installed resume_points() geometry for blocks32/64, tile32, sliding window1024; not a test execution.
